Package com.example.impact.utils

Class FirebaseUtils

java.lang.Object
com.example.impact.utils.FirebaseUtils
public final class FirebaseUtils extends Object
Utility helpers for accessing configured Firebase services. Devs should use the data model classes instead of directly using these methods.
